mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_subscriptions (id, customer_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, device_label, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{deviceLabel}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (endpoint) DO UPDATE SET customer_id = EXCLUDED.customer_id, p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh, auth = EXCLUDED.auth, device_label = EXCLUDED.device_label, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM push_subscriptions WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND endpoint = #{endpoint}
mapper.select: SELECT id, endpoint, p256dh, auth FROM push_subscriptions WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE push_subscriptions SET last_sent_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT preferred_language FROM customers WHERE id = #{customerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
